included.statement: All 65 cases in the frozen manifold-plan oracle, including success, typed error, preview reduction, warnings, identities, provenance, mesh/scene digests, and metrics.
included.enforcement: Independent oracle capture and field-class comparator; every case is one work unit and no case may be filtered or retried.

included.statement: The comparator must detect each of the 18 predeclared one-field or one-invariant mutations without consulting candidate implementation code.
included.enforcement: Each mutation is injected separately into a cloned frozen outcome and must produce the named field-class/path mismatch.

included.statement: Cooperative cancellation, source limit refusal, preview/full policy, and backend cleanup failure remain distinct bounded terminal outcomes.
included.enforcement: Four named terminal work units run in fresh sessions with exact error class/code and no partial success publication.

included.statement: entityId, instanceId, and operationId each publish at 256 UTF-16 code units and refuse at 257 before success publication across Node Worker, actual Vite browser Worker, and MCP child boundaries.
included.enforcement: Six independently controlled values are exercised on every listed transport; a 257 failure must be followed by a successful request in a fresh realm.

included.statement: The qualification lane and Worker URL are transformed and executed by actual Vite in Playwright-managed Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, not a Node WebWorker shim.
included.enforcement: Each browser has its own blocking matrix row and frozen binary digest; success requires the emitted module Worker, started handshake, bounded 257 refusal, deadline termination request, and fresh-epoch recovery.

included.statement: The MCP qualification child has a separate startup handshake/deadline, correlated terminal protocol, bounded cancellation, terminate-and-join hard kill, stdout/stderr containment, join quarantine, and fresh-epoch recovery.
included.enforcement: The supervisor suite runs on Ubuntu Node 20/22, macOS Node 20, and Windows Node 20; all 13 predeclared scenarios pass without retry.

included.statement: Over actual newline-delimited MCP stdio with the real in-memory DuckDB store, a confirmed non-cooperative shadow cannot block ping or tools/list, emits exactly one terminal, writes no late record, and does not prevent the next direct request.
included.enforcement: The child writes a private stdout sentinel and enters a non-cooperative loop before probes; only primary direct builds may appear in history and every server stdout line must remain valid JSON-RPC.

included.statement: Qualification IPC, deadlines, responsiveness, peak RSS, retained-memory deltas, and post-warmup RSS slopes stay within the exact budgets below.
included.enforcement: Serial clean-process resource probes use fixed cycle counts, sample points, regression method, and per-run pass criteria; median-only acceptance is forbidden.

included.statement: Manifold imports remain confined to the narrow kernel adapter and qualification code does not enter the production registry or alter direct-v5 routing.

cleanRunDefinition: Start from exact v5 frozen artifact and disjoint bundle digests in a clean checkout; generated result files and this plan's validator test are outside every source bundle.

Before install, delete root and qualification-only node_modules, build outputs, Vite and Vitest caches, temporary browser profiles, DuckDB files, provisioned browser trees, and prior qualification results.

Construct a sanitized environment from the u02 frozen allowlist; reject NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH, npm override variables, preload hooks, proxies, Playwright browser-path/download overrides, and every unlisted variable.

Verify the u02 exact Node binary, npm CLI 10.9.8 binary and package bytes, Ubuntu 24.04 image, architecture, platform-native DuckDB and esbuild artifacts, and registry identity before importing candidate code.

Install the root graph with npm ci --include=dev --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --audit=false --fund=false and prove root package.json plus package-lock.json contain no Playwright or playwright-core dependency or package node.

Install the isolated browser graph with npm ci --prefix tools/browser-qualification --ignore-scripts --include=dev --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --audit=false --fund=false; platform-optional fsevents remains lock-bound and is installed only where npm admits it.

Recompute every artifact and canonical bundle hash, verify all bound paths are ordinary non-symlink files with LF bytes, and verify all 13 installed Playwright package license files against the frozen license manifest.

Provision browsers only beneath the u03 canonical frozen provision root; before candidate import verify each engine revision, reported version, full archive or installed-tree manifest, executable, helpers, resources, ffmpeg, shared libraries, and all associated license and notice digests.

Use a fresh operating-system job for each clean run; browser rows invoke one outer Linux supervisor per engine and run index, while no warm Worker, Manifold instance, browser process group, database, or module cache crosses a boundary.

Record OS image, architecture, runtime, npm, native-package and browser-tree digests, sanitized-environment digest, seed, start/end timestamps, exact command, exit status, per-unit count, resource samples, and bounded stdout/stderr artifact digests.
Do not retry a failed work unit, filter a case, adjust a timeout/budget, or substitute a browser build inside the same candidate run.
executionProtocol.concurrencyPolicy: one qualification row per fresh process; memory rows serial; no shared worker realm between units
executionProtocol.admissionRule: all bindings frozen, no unresolved rows that block execution, and execution authorization recorded
executionProtocol.passRule: every matrix row passes every required clean run within frozen budgets; zero false-complete; no skipped unit; no result reuse

resetPolicy.unitFailure: reject-candidate; no rerun-to-green within the same candidate run
resetPolicy.infrastructureFailure: invalidate the entire clean run; one documented restart allowed only after proving candidate code did not execute
resetPolicy.mutationsAfterFreeze: any scoped source, oracle, comparator, harness, dependency, seed, threshold, or environment change requires a new plan version and resets all counters

triggers.condition: Any path in a frozen artifact or bundle changes bytes or membership.
Node, browser, operating-system image, package-lock, Vite, TypeScript, serializer, or Manifold dependency identity changes.
Scope, oracle, comparator, mutation, seed, work count, clean-run count, budget, timeout, reset rule, or pass rule changes.
Any planned unit has an unexpected terminal, mismatch, timeout, budget breach, stdout contamination, late persistence, skipped case, or retry.
A host/provisioning failure occurs and logs prove candidate code and browser Worker were never imported or executed.
A failure is labelled infrastructure-related but candidate execution cannot be ruled out.

unresolvedRows.resolution: Freeze the exact Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows OS images; Node binaries; npm CLI 10.9.8 binary and package bytes; registry identity; platform-native DuckDB and esbuild artifacts; and the complete sanitized environment allowlist, then replace every u02 runtime placeholder in a new plan version.

Under one canonical provision root, freeze each Playwright-managed Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit revision and reported version plus complete archive or installed-tree manifests covering executables, helpers, resources, ffmpeg and shared libraries, with every browser-distribution license and notice digest; verify containment and the full tree both before and after each run.
Once execution admission is ready, execute all 6270 planned work units in the required clean runs and publish a separate append-only result artifact; no prior green result may be imported.
Assign an organizationally independent reviewer who did not author the candidate, oracle, comparator, or plan, and record a decision against the frozen plan and new result artifact.
A release authority records approve or reject after all evidence and independent review; even approval does not authorize production cutover under this plan.
